packageRules.description: pip packages minor/patch (flask 3.1.3 → 3.2.0): Renovate merges once the end-to-end test is green; the merge makes an automatic patch release
Python image patch (3.14.9 → 3.14.10): merged once the test is green, automatic patch release
Major updates (flask 4.0) and Python minor (3.14 → 3.15, a new language version): PR only, merged by hand
One PR for werkzeug + flask, they release together
GitHub Actions minor/patch: merged once CI is green, no release (the image doesn't change); major by hand
